The certification of Accudyne’s Quality Management System represents a major step forward for the company and is part of their strategic growth plan to be executed over the next several years. […]
html: The audit, performed by DEKRA in the 3rd quarter of 2017, was the culmination of the Accudyne ISO working group’s efforts over several months.  The certification of Accudyne’s Quality Management System represents a major step forward for the company and is part of their strategic growth plan to be executed over the next several years.  Stay tuned for more !
